title: Cancel, X or Escape on the clear-shifts question puts the card back (release)
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · Schedule access · about 15 minutes.
  • Sign in as an Admin (on a QA branch: the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView"). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide; narrower windows show only the List.
  • Work in one location throughout, shown next to the bell in the top bar (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials (top right) > Change Location. Create everything in that location.
  • Two technicians named exactly "Esther Howard" ([Tech-A]) and "Ralph Edwards" ([Tech-B]); the expected results quote these names.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel" (this case only) with one Approved work order [WO-1] led by Esther Howard, and a shift for her on it tomorrow 8:00–12:00.

Setup

  1. Technicians: your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff. A person counts as a technician only if Active, Time Clock on, Role not Office User or Time Clock User, and this location in Location. To add one: New Staff Member > First Name, Last Name, Email, Role "Technician", one Department (required), Location = this location, Time Clock on > Save & Close. You need: "Esther Howard" and "Ralph Edwards".
  2. Customer: Customers > New Customer > Name "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel" > Save. On its Contacts tab > New Contact > First and Last Name > Save. On its Assets tab > New Asset > pick the contact, Year, Make (required), Model, Unit "TRK-118" > Save.
  3. Work orders for "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel": Work Orders > Create Work Order > pick the Customer and its Asset > Save (if a credit-limit Confirmation appears, click Create). In the New Line form that opens, type in "What Are You Doing?" and pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"), turn Line Approved on > Save & Close: the status reads Approved. Write down the work order number (top left). Then pick the lead in Lead Technician on the card at the left of the work order page; it saves at once.
    • [WO-1]: lead = Esther Howard.
  4. Schedule > go to tomorrow > drag [WO-1] from the work order list onto Esther Howard's row at 8:00 > choose Entire work order > set the end time to 12:00 > save.
  5. Check: tomorrow's Schedule shows Esther Howard's 8:00–12:00 shift on [WO-1], and [WO-1] shows Lead Technician Esther Howard.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Board View in the display switcher (right side of the toolbar; tooltip "Board View").
  2. Type "ZZAUTOTEST F1 Prompt Cancel" in Search.
  3. Drag the card from [Tech-A]'s column into [Tech-B]'s column.
  4. In the question click Cancel.
  5. Drag the card into [Tech-B]'s column again.
  6. Close the question with its close (X) button.
  7. Drag the card into [Tech-B]'s column again.
  8. Press Escape on the keyboard.
  9. Click the card to open the work order.
  10. Open the Schedule for tomorrow.
  11. Open Work Orders again and click Tech View in the display switcher.
  12. Repeat steps 3 to 8 with the work order's row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Steps 1 and 2: [WO-1]'s card shows in Esther Howard's column.
  • Steps 3, 5 and 7: a question about Esther Howard's scheduled shifts appears.
  • Steps 4, 6 and 8: After Cancel, after X and after Escape, the dragged card goes back to its place in Esther Howard's column.
  • Steps 9 and 10: In the end nothing changed: Lead Technician is Esther Howard and her 8:00–12:00 shift is still on the Schedule.
  • Step 11: Tech View opens with [WO-1]'s row in Esther Howard's group.
  • Step 12: Tech View behaves the same: the question appears for each drag, and after Cancel, after X and after Escape the row goes back to its place in Esther Howard's group.
  • Note: clicking an empty part of the page outside the question does not close it; the question simply stays open. That is expected and is not a fault (QA lead's decision below).

Release copy of C368135 (in the Fast-follow folder). It leaves out the lead technician dialog path (opening the dialog from More actions, then Cancel in the question) and any statement about the lead-change message, which waits on SV-11522 / SV-11524: Chris Ward (product owner) made these fast-follows for after the release (Slack, 20 Oct 2026, https://shopview.slack.com/archives/C0C41RV3T3L/p1792455057423139).

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; story SV-10047 (Story 4, Reassign or unassign the lead technician); PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 68 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), S4-R30, read 19 Oct 2026. PO decision Chris Ward 6 Oct 2026 ("Cancel undoes the move"). Escape as a way of closing the question: the design system's dialog behaviour in the 8 Oct design export.
  • QA lead decision, 9 Oct 2026: clicking outside the clear-shifts question does not close it, and that is not a defect.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S4-R30: “Cancel, or closing the prompt, calls the change off. A dragged card goes back to where it was; from the dialog the user is back in the dialog with nothing changed.”

Not yet checked against a build in this wording.

AUTOMATION: READY
